facts.text: Doral's golf resort opened in the 1960s and was frequented by celebrities and moguls of the game.
facts.excerpt: Doral's legendary golf resort was instantly iconic when it opened in the 1960s, frequented by celebrities and moguls of the game.

facts.text: Doral first opened its doors in 1962 and was fashioned with golf at its core.
facts.excerpt: First opening our doors in 1962, Doral was fashioned with golf at its core.

facts.text: The resort has four championship golf courses, including the Blue Monster.
facts.excerpt: Tee it up on any of our four championship golf courses, including the legendary Blue Monster

facts.text: Besides the Blue Monster, the courses are the Red Tiger, the Golden Palm and the Silver Fox.
facts.excerpt: With the most recent course transformations of The Red Tiger, The Golden Palm, and The Silver Fox

facts.text: Architect Gil Hanse led a complete redesign of the Blue Monster course.
facts.excerpt: With legendary architect Gil Hanse at the helm, our historic Blue Monster Course has undergone a complete redesign

facts.text: The Blue Monster's 18th hole is traditionally ranked as one of the most difficult on the PGA TOUR.
facts.excerpt: The famous 18th hole is traditionally ranked as one of the most difficult on the PGA TOUR.

facts.text: Jack Nicklaus won twice, Greg Norman three times and Tiger Woods four times on the Blue Monster.
facts.excerpt: Jack Nicklaus won twice, Greg Norman three times and Tiger Woods four

facts.text: The resort also has an LED practice facility and the Trump Golf Academy.
facts.excerpt: Rounding out the resort's golf offerings are the state-of-the-art LED practice facility and The Trump Golf Academy.

facts.text: The resort has a 48,000 sq. ft. spa.
facts.excerpt: embark on a rejuvenating journey at our luxurious 48,000 sq. ft. spa

facts.text: Rooms and suites are designed as intimate villa-like lodges just steps from the main clubhouse and golf courses.

facts.text: BLT Prime is a contemporary steakhouse that starts meals with signature warm popovers.

facts.text: The Experience Salon is an intimate whiskey and bourbon lounge with private tastings by appointment.
